evidence_quotes: Valmet has been selected to deliver a Valmet DNAe Distributed Control System (DCS) to Kainuun Voima’s Koivukoski II, Koivukoski III and Ämmäkoski hydropower plants in Kajaani, Finland.
data.date_evidence: Valmet Oyj’s trade press release, November 4, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. EET
data.reason: The item reports on a contract won by the Finnish parent company Valmet Oyj, not the Norwegian subsidiary VALMET AS.
